title: Aayiye chacha Abbas
body:
Qoo'N Tapak Raha Hai Mere Kaano'N Se, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
Lag Rahe Hai Pusht Par Mere Durre, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
Nange Paou'N Chal Rahi Hun Jangal Mein, Bas Nahi Hai Ab Mujhme.
Chubh Rahe Hai Paoun Mein Mere Kaante, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ammju Jaan Hai Bada Kathin Manzar, Natawaan Abid Asws.
Log Phenkte Hai Aag Ke Shole, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
Haddiya'N Bhi Khushk Hogayi Meri Jaa Rahi Hai Beenayi.
Pyas Se Labo'N Pe Pad Gaye Chaale, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ammu Jaan Yeh Sitam Hua Humpar, Ehle Shaam Has Has Kar.
Phainkte Hai Ahlebait Asws. Par Sadqe, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
Choomte The Pyar Se Jinhe Baba, Roz Dete The Bosa.
Dekhiye Wo Gaal Pad Gaye Neele, Aayiye Chacha Abbas Asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
Az: Meer Kumail Ali(Anjuman E Asghari)
